edits.old: because the data lake is removed (GAP-0340; ASM-0434).
edits.new: because the data lake is removed (GAP-0340; ASM-0434). Before the ACE batch record exists, freshness is read from the batch-status view v_ace_batch_status populated with synthetic batch rows in SIT; where that view is absent the product is shown as not stamped, and no date is inferred from a row count, a file or a view's data date (GAP-1507). The source time of the stamp is the batch started_at and the load time is the batch completed_at (GAP-0492). AceDataReady and AceDataLate are published by rwb-source-data on rwb.source-data.events.v1 and keyed by sourceSystem and businessDate; the envelope carries id, source, type, specversion, time, subject (the source system) and datacontenttype, and the seven payload fields are typed in the AsyncAPI document; the registry subject is named by the platform event owner, and the login is referenced as the rwb_source_data login (DP-02) until it is allocated (GAP-0493). ACE ingestion is not a producer of these events on a Recovery topic (GAP-1504). The ready call of the bank scheduler and its status read are implemented with a poll of the ACE batch record as the fallback, and the path live at go-live is confirmed before the integration test (GAP-1513).
